#  KEYBINDINGS — dusk
#  Source: etc/skel/.config/dusk/dusk.cfg (runtime libconfig — keybindings list)
#  Generated: 2026.07.17 for /kiro-create-x11-twm — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
#  Note: dusk uses WORKSPACES (not tags). Workspace digits super + 1..9 use the
#  physical number row (AZERTY: same physical keys).
###############################################################################

── 1. Applications & Launchers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + Return          alacritty (terminal)
  super + t               alacritty (terminal)
  ctrl + alt + t          alacritty (terminal)
  super + shift + Return  thunar (file manager)
  super + d               rofi drun (app launcher)
  super + F11 / F12       rofi drun (app launcher)
  super + F1              vivaldi-stable (browser)
  super + F2              code (editor)
  super + F3              inkscape
  super + F4              gimp
  super + F5              meld
  super + F6              vlc
  super + F7              virtualbox
  super + F8              thunar (file manager)
  super + F9              virt-manager
  super + F10             spotify
  ctrl + alt + f          firefox (browser)
  ctrl + alt + b          brave (browser)
  ctrl + alt + c / g      chromium (browser)
  ctrl + alt + v          vivaldi-stable (browser)
  ctrl + alt + o          opera (browser)
  ctrl + alt + d          obs
  ctrl + alt + e          archlinux-tweak-tool
  ctrl + alt + a / q      alacritty-tweak-tool
  ctrl + alt + s          fish-tweak-tool
  ctrl + alt + z / w      fastfetch-tweak-tool
  ctrl + alt + i          kiro-iso-builder
  ctrl + alt + p          pamac-manager
  ctrl + alt + m          mintstick (iso writer)
  ctrl + alt + u          pavucontrol
  super + shift + Escape  xkill

── 2. Window Management ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + q               close focused window
  super + z               hide / show focused window
  super + g               toggle floating
  super + ctrl + g        center floating window (80% of screen)
  super + f               toggle fullscreen
  super + shift + f       toggle fake fullscreen
  super + n               move window to / from master (zoom)
  super + j / k           focus next / previous window in stack
  super + Left/Right/Up/Down   focus window in that direction
  super + ctrl + Left/Right/Up/Down   swap places with window in that direction
  super + ctrl + j / k    move window down / up the stack
  super + m               mark / unmark window (for group actions)
  super + a               mark all windows
  super + shift + a       unmark all windows
  super + v / shift + v   group / ungroup floating windows
  super + b               toggle the bar

── 3. Workspaces / Tags / Groups ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + 1..9            view workspace 1..9
  super + shift + 1..9    move focused window to workspace 1..9
  super + ctrl + 1..9     send focused window to workspace 1..9 (keep it here too)
  super + alt + 1..9      enable workspace 1..9 alongside the current one
  super + ctrl + shift + 1..9   move all windows to workspace 1..9
  super + 0               view all occupied workspaces on this monitor
  super + ctrl + 0        view all workspaces on this monitor
  super + o               view the selected workspace
  super + comma / period  view previous / next occupied workspace
  super + Tab             view previous / next occupied workspace
  super + backslash       pin / unpin the current workspace

── 4. Layout & Tiling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + space           toggle previous layout
  super + i / u           increase / decrease windows in the master area
  super + ctrl + i / u    increase / decrease windows in the primary stack
  super + h / l           shrink / grow the master area (mfact)
  super + shift + h / l   shrink / grow the focused window (cfact)
  super + shift + o       reset window size factor
  super + bracketleft/right   rotate layout split / arrangement
  super + ctrl + m        mirror layout (flip master and stack)
  super + ctrl + shift + m    flip layout horizontal / vertical

── 5. Multi-monitor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + shift + comma / period   focus previous / next monitor
  super + alt + comma / period     send window to previous / next monitor
  super + alt + shift + comma / period   send all windows to adjacent monitor

── 6. Multimedia & Hardware ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  (audio via the volctl tray applet; brightness via brightnessctl —
   hardware keys are handled by the desktop, not bound in dusk.cfg)

── 7. Screenshots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + shift + s       flameshot (region screenshot GUI)

── 8. System & Session ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + ctrl + s        show this keybindings cheatsheet (kiro-keybindings)
  super + ctrl + l        lock the screen (betterlockscreen)
  ctrl + alt + r          lock the screen (archlinux-betterlockscreen)
  super + x               logout screen (archlinux-logout)
  ctrl + alt + k          logout screen (archlinux-logout)
  ctrl + alt + l          logout settings (archlinux-logout --settings)
  super + shift + x       powermenu (edu-powermenu)
  super + shift + q       restart dusk
  super + ctrl + alt + q  quit dusk (exit the session)
